scope: Public zero-cash routes under no-account/no-payment/no-protected-payload mission limits; not proof that no free dataset exists anywhere.

Recent 7-14-day randomized trial requires an account and cannot cover the frozen period. Existing V0.2 four-year schema witness preserved.

Options hourly collection starts 2026-09-30; free endpoint serves latest two hours. Published columns omit bid/ask size. No current/protected data downloaded.
